zh: 新项目可留在这台电脑，主机离线时也能继续工作。
主机可按项目授权跟随。配对电脑可双向搬移项目、任务历史与 Jefa 看板。
任务按需读取适用的习惯，可从 FLA 页在另一客户端新开会话。
en: Keep a new project on this computer and continue working offline.
Grant access by project. Move projects, task history and Jefa boards between paired computers.
Tasks load preferences on demand. Open a new chat in another client from the FLA page.
